canonical_source.author: Pallavi Raonka
canonical_source.title: Munda Politics and Land: Understanding Indigeneity in Jharkhand, India

exact_locator_candidates.supported_statement: The dissertation reports a fifteen-month ethnographic study conducted from May 2017 to December 2018 and analyzes meanings of land for the Munda community in relation to Adivasi-State conflict.

canonicalization.rule: Treat repository landing page, dissertation PDF, supporting documents, catalogue/index records and citations as manifestations/records of one dissertation, not independent corroborating sources.
canonicalization.dependency_warning: Author interpretations, participant accounts and historical-source claims must be separated at proposition level before promotion.

rights_access_consent.reason: Public institutional-repository availability does not itself establish permission to redistribute the dissertation file, supporting documents, field materials, quotations, images or participant-derived content in MLHKP.

required_before_promotion: obtain and hash authoritative repository PDF where permitted
verify title-page metadata and PDF/printed pagination
inspect methodology, field sites, participant/sample description and consent/ethics statements
separate participant evidence, historical dependencies and author interpretation
verify reuse/quotation/image permissions and cultural-governance constraints

gap_policy: Unverified, restricted, culturally sensitive or context-dependent material remains an explicit gap and is not promoted as a general Munda cultural claim.
